_doc: What tools/model_watch.py looks for each week: per category, the Hugging Face pipeline tags to read (the most-trending models first), and words that must appear in a model's name or tags ("need", any one of them). "known" lists repos we already use or have tested beyond the ones in imagegen/models.json, voice/*.json (read automatically), so they are not reported as new.
_makers_doc: a repo whose name has one of these words but whose author is not one of the listed makers is someone else's copy, repack or add-on of that model, not a new model

blocked_licences.minimax-h3-image-community-license-agree: bars any use, even running it, in the US, EU, UK and South Korea (read 2026-11-10)
blocked_licences.minimax-h3-community-license-agreement: same territory ban as H3 Image

_blocked_doc: licences we read and ruled out: models under them are left out of the report (name: why)
